exams.name: Commission-approved real estate licensing exam (national portion and Idaho state portion)
exams.notes: Applicant must pass both the national portion and the Idaho state portion within 12 months immediately preceding the date of the license application. Waiver of national portion available for those actively licensed in another state.
exams.jurisdiction: national portion and Idaho state portion, administered by or through the commission
exams.quote: an individual applicant seeking a primary Idaho real estate license shall take and pass the national portion and the Idaho state portion of an approved exam administered by or through the commission.

interval_years.quote: Each new license shall be for a period of one (1) year plus the months up to and including the next birthday of the licensee, not to exceed a period of two (2) years, and shall expire on the birthday of the licensee.

required.quote: A licensee shall not submit an application to renew a license on active status or to activate an inactive license without having obtained the continuing education credit hours required by section 54-2023, Idaho Code.

hours_per_period.quote: shall successfully complete two (2) commission core courses, plus twelve (12) classroom hours of continuing education credit

period_years.quote: Commission core course means the annual course covering the twelve (12) month period between July 1 and June 30

value: Two commission core courses

available.quote: An individual who is currently and actively licensed as a real estate broker or salesperson in another state or jurisdiction at the time of application for a primary Idaho real estate license shall meet all qualifications listed in section 54-2012, Idaho Code, for the type of license sought, except that the applicant shall not be required to furnish proof of the educational prerequisites

requirements.value: Active license in another state/jurisdiction; must provide certified license history; national exam may be waived; full reciprocal licensure available by written agreement between Idaho and the other jurisdiction.
requirements.quote: An individual who is currently and actively licensed in another state or jurisdiction that administers a real estate exam may be issued a primary Idaho license without further exam or proof of educational prerequisites pursuant to written agreement between Idaho and the other state or jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in a continued or flagrant course of misrepresentation or making of false promises
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in a continued or flagrant course of misrepresentation or making of false promises, whether done personally or through agents or salespersons

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to account for or remit property or moneys belonging to another
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to account for or remit any property, real or personal, or moneys coming into the person's possession which belong to another

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to keep adequate records of all property transactions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to keep adequate records of all property transactions in which the person acts in the capacity of real estate broker or salesperson

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure or refusal to disclose information or produce documents for commission inspection
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure or refusal, upon lawful demand, to disclose any information within the person's knowledge, or to produce any documents, books or records in the person's possession for inspection by the commission or its authorized representative

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting as a real estate broker or salesperson under an assumed name
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting as a real estate broker or salesperson under an assumed name

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employment of fraud, deception, misrepresentation, or unlawful means in applying for or securing a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employment of fraud, deception, misrepresentation, misstatement or any unlawful means in applying for or securing a license to act as a real estate broker or salesperson in the state of Idaho

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using, proposing to use, or agreeing to use a double contract
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using, proposing to use, or agreeing to use a "double contract" as prohibited in section 54-2054(5), Idaho Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Seeking or receiving a kickback or rebate prohibited by statute
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Seeking or receiving a "kickback" or rebate prohibited in section 54-2054(6), Idaho Code

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of the real estate licensing statutes or commission rules or orders
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any provision of sections 54-2001 through 54-2097, Idaho Code, or any administrative rule made or promulgated by the commission or any final order of the commission

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any other conduct constituting dishonest or dishonorable dealings
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any other conduct whether of the same or a different character than hereinabove specified which constitutes dishonest or dishonorable dealings

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence or reckless conduct in a regulated real estate transaction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross negligence or reckless conduct in a regulated real estate transaction. Conduct is grossly negligent or reckless if, when taken as a whole, it is conduct which substantially fails to meet the generally accepted standard of care in the practice of real estate in Idaho.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or misdemeanor involving fraud, misrepresentation, or dishonest dealing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of a felony, or has been convicted of a misdemeanor involving fraud, misrepresentation, or dishonest or dishonorable dealing or which otherwise demonstrates the licensee's lack of trustworthiness to engage in the real estate business

disciplinary_grounds.description: Judgment entered in a civil action upon grounds of fraud, misrepresentation, deceit or gross negligence in a real estate transaction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has a judgment entered against the licensee in a civil action upon grounds of fraud, misrepresentation, deceit or gross negligence with reference to a real estate-related transaction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Order or determination of debarment, suspension, or limitation on participation in government loan programs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has an order or determination of debarment, suspension, or any limitation on participation in government loan programs issued against the licensee for misconduct

disciplinary_grounds.description: Real estate or other professional license suspended or revoked for disciplinary violation involving fraud, misrepresentation, or dishonest dealings
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has a real estate or other professional license suspended or revoked for a disciplinary violation involving fraud, misrepresentation, or dishonest or dishonorable dealings.

insurance_required.quote: Each licensee who is actively licensed under this chapter shall, as a condition to licensing, carry and maintain errors and omissions insurance to cover all licensed activities under the provisions of this chapter.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: Each individual licensed as a designated real estate broker under the provisions of this chapter shall be required to have and maintain a definite, physical place of business, which place shall serve as his main office for the transaction of business

definition_quote.value: Any person other than a real estate salesperson who, directly or indirectly, while acting for another for compensation or a promise or an expectation thereof, engages in any of the following: sells, lists, buys, or negotiates, or offers to sell, list, buy or negotiate the purchase, sale, option or exchange of real estate or any interest therein or business opportunity or interest therein for others
definition_quote.quote: Any person other than a real estate salesperson who, directly or indirectly, while acting for another for compensation or a promise or an expectation thereof, engages in any of the following: sells, lists, buys, or negotiates, or offers to sell, list, buy or negotiate the purchase, sale, option or exchange of real estate or any interest therein or business opportunity or interest therein for others

license_tiers.quote: An individual may be licensed as a real estate salesperson, an associate broker or a designated broker acting for a sole proprietorship or legal business entity.

broker_of_record_required.quote: Each legal business entity shall have a properly licensed individual designated broker who shall be held responsible for the activities of the licensed entity.

pre_exam_experience_years.quote: Provide satisfactory evidence of having been actively engaged, on a full-time basis, for two (2) years as a licensed real estate salesperson within the last five (5) years immediately prior to the date upon which the individual makes application.

pre_exam_instruction_hours.quote: Applicants seeking a broker's or associate broker's license shall, in addition to meeting the requirements for a salesperson's license, successfully complete specified courses in advanced real estate study, for a minimum of ninety (90) additional classroom hours.

value: Business conduct and office operations course
Advanced real estate study (minimum 90 additional classroom hours for broker/associate broker)
required_instruction_topics.quote: Business conduct and office operations course means the component of the advanced real estate course that is required in order to obtain a broker license and that teaches business practices and office operations of the brokerage, including recordkeeping, trust account procedures and the laws governing those practices.

license_revocation_reapplication_waiting.quote: after a period of five (5) years from the date the license was revoked, the applicant may make a written request to the commission for an exemption review to determine the applicant's suitability for licensure

agency_relationship_types.quote: The following types of brokerage relationships are recognized: (a) Nonagency; (b) Agency representation; (c) Limited dual agency representation; (d) Limited dual agency with assigned agents.

dual_agency_written_consent_required.quote: A brokerage may represent both the buyer and the seller in the same transaction only as a limited dual agent and only with the express written consent of all other clients involved in the transaction.

designated_agency_permitted.quote: A brokerage acting as a limited dual agent may, at the option of the brokerage and with the express written consent of the other clients involved in the transaction, assign separate sales associates to each client to act on behalf of and represent that client solely.

transaction_licensee_role_permitted.quote: "Nonagent" means a brokerage and its licensees working with or assisting a buyer or seller as a customer to which the duties provided in section 54-2086, Idaho Code, are applicable.

initial_interview_disclosure_required.quote: A licensee shall give to a prospective buyer or seller at the first substantial business contact the agency disclosure brochure adopted or approved by the Idaho real estate commission.

written_service_agreement_required.quote: A buyer or seller is not represented by a brokerage in a regulated real estate transaction unless the buyer or seller and the brokerage agree, in a separate written document, to such representation.

A legal description of the property
sales_contract_mandatory_disclosures.quote: The broker or sales associate shall make certain that all offers to purchase real property or any interest therein are in writing and contain all of the following specific terms, provisions and statements

listing_contract_termination_date_requir.quote: Conspicuous and definite beginning and expiration dates

transaction_record_retention_years.quote: The following records must be kept by a broker for three (3) calendar years after the year in which the event occurred, the transaction closed, all funds were disbursed, or the agreement and any written extension expired

escrow_account_required.quote: immediately upon receipt, the broker shall deposit entrusted moneys in a neutral, qualified trust fund account

escrow_deposit_deadline_business_days.quote: All moneys received by a broker for another in a real estate transaction are to be deposited on or before the banking day immediately following the receipt day of such funds

commingling_of_funds_prohibited.quote: Entrusted moneys shall not be commingled with moneys of the broker, firm or agent, except for that minimum amount that may be required to open and maintain the trust account

fixed_office_required.quote: Each individual licensed as a designated real estate broker under the provisions of this chapter shall be required to have and maintain a definite, physical place of business, which place shall serve as his main office for the transaction of business

branch_office_associate_broker_required.quote: The designated broker shall designate in the application a branch manager, who shall be an associate broker and who, within three (3) years immediately prior to the designation, shall have completed a commission-approved business conduct and office operations course, to regularly occupy and be responsible for the supervision of the branch office.

salesperson_broker_affiliation_required.quote: No Idaho sales associate may be licensed under or associated with more than one (1) Idaho broker at a time

qualified_association_permitted.quote: a broker shall not pay any part or share of a commission, fee or compensation received in the licensee's capacity as such in a regulated real estate transaction to any person who is not actively licensed as a real estate broker in Idaho or in another state or jurisdiction... This section shall not prohibit payment of a part or share of a commission, fee or compensation by the broker to an unlicensed legal business entity, if: (a) All of the entity's shareholders, members or other persons having a similar ownership interest are active real estate licensees; and (b) An owner licensed under the broker performed the licensed activities for which the payment is made.

recovery_fund_exists.quote: If, pursuant to court order, the commission pays from the recovery fund any amount in settlement of a claim or towards satisfaction of a judgment against a licensed broker, associate broker or salesperson

broker_price_opinion_permitted.quote: Only an actively licensed broker or associate broker may prepare and render a broker price opinion, as defined in this chapter.

comparative_market_analysis_permitted.quote: An actively licensed salesperson or broker may, in the ordinary course of business, give an opinion of the price of real estate for the purpose of a prospective listing or sale.

value: Purchase, option, exchange or sale of any interest in real property for a person's own account or use
Acquisition, exchange or disposition by owner or regular employee of owner within scope of employment
Sale by duly authorized attorney in fact for a single transaction

Acquisition or disposition by attorney at law in connection with client representation, if not regularly engaged in real estate business
